summary: Bundle bndl-cd1018d48b2b57c5 (Northside Clinic, 2026-11-10 06:22-15:22Z). The evidence does not support an incident. No local log removal was established: the workstation auth.log gap at 09:08Z coincides with scheduled logrotate (.1 retained), and records auth.log matches the collector. No data staging allegation was supported in the sampled review. Bulk outbound flows over 5 MB went only to approved destinations (10.20.0.45 backup NAS; 10.20.8.20 lab gateway). The 12:18Z 22.5 MB flow to the backup NAS (port 873) is consistent with a scheduled backup, but its source (10.20.0.10) is not mapped to the workstation. The 13:13Z kcole upload to 10.20.8.20 is approved by destination, but its authorization is not established. Accounts (kcole, tmori, adm-bsato, svc-backup) identify credentials only; the human operator is not established and no person is named or cleared.
